prostate_study.model: LNCaP cancer cells; no BUB1B mutant, normal-muscle or normal-cell comparator established in this study.
prostate_study.medium: RPMI1640 with5% defined bovine serum, reported13nM basal selenium.
prostate_study.replication: Explicitly one SM array at each time point and no replicate arrays. MSA expression data reused from earlier work; not an independently replicated simultaneous trial.
prostate_study.BUB1B_assay: Table6 lists BUB1B as higher under SM than MSA in between-treatment SAM analysis. No gene-specific comparison versus untreated cells or BUBR1 protein rescue is thereby established.
prostate_study.SAM_scope: Paper reports366 unique between-treatment genes at0.5% false detection rate; this is not a new independent gene-specific rescue confidence estimate.
prostate_study.orthogonal_validation: Eight PCR targets exclude BUB1B. Triplicate amplification is not evidence of independent culture replicates.

cell_cycle_48h.figure_significance: All three G2/M treated conditions starred; G1 decrease starred only at50/100µM. Exact test/P/independent culture units are insufficiently specified.
cell_cycle_48h.interpretation: Phase redistribution/arrest, not faithful chromosome segregation or tissue-function rescue.
cell_cycle_48h.higher_dose_hypodiploidy: Text reports increased subG0/G1 at50/100µM as suggestive of apoptosis; Figure5 does not plot that subpopulation, and no independent apoptosis assay was qualified here.

reporter_24h.assay: PSA-luciferase normalized using beta-galactosidase, three independent transfections reported.
reporter_24h.finding: Prose describes no effect at10µM SM and about60% reduction at50µM, comparable to10µM MSA. Native Figure6 does not visibly show the caption-described significance stars; no new P value inferred.
reporter_24h.limit: Promoter output in cancer cells is not physiological muscle/renewal/fidelity benefit.

GEO_metadata_check.reference_channel_limit: All ten Cy3 channel1 source labels name14.5uM selenium LNCaP totalRNA, while the manuscript describes vehicle controls. The reference cannot be silently relabeled untreated.
GEO_metadata_check.probe_annotation_limit: GPL3284 has43008 rows and GB_LIST clone accessions, without a gene-symbol column. No BUB1B/BUBR1 literal or NM_001211 accession match was found. No sequence-based remapping performed.
GEO_metadata_check.expression_claim: No BUB1B numeric expression estimate or rescue ratio is calculated from this unresolved metadata.

antimutagenesis_followup.reported_positive: Primary abstract reports reduced carboplatin-associated reporter-gene mutagenesis in mouse bone marrow with both SeMet and MSA.
antimutagenesis_followup.retained_as: Source-limited protective/genome-damage research lead, not dismissed as a gene-expression association.
not_inferred: exact delivered regimen or in-vivo versus cultured-marrow exposure
XPC mediation in this new assay rather than referenced previous work
antimutagenesis_followup.access_attempts: Publisher full HTML and PDF403; no barrier bypass or substitution of review-reported doses as verified primary facts.

clinical_counterevidence.population: SELECT older relatively healthy men;34887 in primary analysis, not MVA patients.
clinical_counterevidence.intervention: 200µg/day selenium as L-selenomethionine, compared with matched placebo in a four-arm trial.
clinical_counterevidence.interpretation: No significant prostate-prevention benefit in this trial; neither a significant selenium harm claim nor evidence against MSA/MVA efficacy. VitaminE-alone significant harm is a separate arm.

competitive_decision: Retain distinct cell-cycle/transcription comparators and a source-limited antimutagenesis lead. Do not nominate either as demonstrated BUBR1 restoration or muscle compensation. RelativeSM>MSA RNA, cancer-cell arrest and reporter-gene mutation protection do not establish useful function in the relevant BUB1B model. Current niacin/apitegromab nominees also remain unproved inMVA; no quantitative comparative efficacy probability assigned.
